companies.name: Sprouts.ai
companies.discription: Designed production Generative AI and NLP pipelines for enterprise contact enrichment using LLM reasoning, semantic retrieval, and entity resolution over a large-scale Elasticsearch index. Built inference and retrieval services with Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, TensorFlow, and PyTorch for chat, embeddings, batch processing, ranking, and semantic search. Shipped full-stack product features in TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, and Tailwind CSS—intelligence dashboards, graph-based discovery, network visualizations, hierarchy views, and AI-powered workflows—collaborating on designs with Figma and Claude Design. Owned two production FastAPI microservices for enrichment orchestration with JWT, OAuth2, multi-tenant RBAC, provider routing, async processing, caching, rate limiting, and bulk processing. Engineered data processing and retrieval evaluation (preprocessing, normalization, feature engineering, query-regression testing) and operated services on Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and Helm.

companies.name: TekGigz LLC
companies.discription: Built a finance-focused web application with Python, Flask, Django, and PostgreSQL for transaction processing, vendor management, and real-time financial reporting. Delivered secure REST APIs (−20% response time), optimized PostgreSQL schemas and SQL (+25% query performance), and built responsive HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript reporting dashboards (−10% user support requests). Created automated test suites with PyTest and CI/CD with Jenkins/Docker (−15% deploy issues, +30% release speed) on Heroku.

companies.name: PTC Onshape Inc.
companies.discription: Contributed to a cloud-based engineering design platform by building scalable error-handling infrastructure and performance-optimized frontend components. Designed a custom data structure to detect and propagate errors across interconnected engineering models, shipped modular React/Angular components with model validators and real-time error indicators, and improved frontend responsiveness by ~20% while integrating modules into Jenkins/Docker CI/CD.

companies.name: Adidas
companies.discription: Led campus outreach initiatives by coordinating student teams, managing project execution, and collaborating with brand representatives. Organized virtual events and data-driven digital campaigns, using engagement metrics to improve outreach and community participation.
